title: Engineering molecular potential energy surfaces using magnetic cavity quantum electrodynamics
summary: We investigate the effects of coupling a quantum-magnetic cavity field to molecules. Our high-precision auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo calculations capture the effect of the cavity field in the presence of electron correlations, and their interplay and competition. In H$_2$, we find that a strong enough cavity coupling makes the original bound ground state metastable, along with inverting the singlet-triplet gap.
